name: comfyui-lyonir-studio
description: Lyonir Studio custom nodes for ComfyUI

lyonir.ltxPostSampling: automatic IC-LoRA guide crop before decode
lyonir.samplerInputLayout: negative directly below conditioning; negative remains optional

saveImageGallery.storage: persistent output files + per-node history manifest
saveImageGallery.ui: larger preview-first responsive image gallery with compact thumbnail strip and hidden empty-state text
saveImageGallery.layout: transparent seamless surface reveals the exact node body color; larger preview area; compact control row; no empty-state text; no internal black panel
saveImageGallery.resizePolicy: compact native default; ComfyUI owns DOM widget layout; preview/thumbnails expand only from explicit user resize; no computedHeight feedback loop
saveImageGallery.surfacePolicy: all non-image gallery surfaces and the immediate DOM host match the node background exactly
saveImageGallery.interaction: left-click preview is passive; right-click opens ComfyUI node menu with Open Image, Copy Image, Save Image, MaskEditor; Open button remains explicit
saveImageGallery.contextMenu: forces ComfyUI node context menu and suppresses browser-native image menu

saveVideoGallery.encoding: Internal compatibility encoder; packaged FFmpeg; no external VideoHelperSuite required
saveVideoGallery.storage: Video Combine master output + persistent per-node UUID-keyed Lyonir history manifest + gallery thumbnails/proxies when needed
saveVideoGallery.ui: Video Combine-dominant preview: the current video fills essentially the full usable node width; prior-video history remains a deliberately small strip below it.
saveVideoGallery.videoOutput: same VHS_FILENAMES return contract as Video Combine
saveVideoGallery.interaction: latest successful save becomes the main preview automatically; prior outputs are selectable below; right-click is forwarded into ComfyUI native node context menu exactly like VHS
saveVideoGallery.surfacePolicy: transparent seamless surface reveals exact node body color; larger preview area; compact control row; no internal black/contrasting panel
saveVideoGallery.resizePolicy: Strict width-driven proportional resizing. Any resize request is normalized through setSize and onResize: width is the only free dimension, height is automatically recomputed from all controls plus the Video Combine-style media aspect ratio. Horizontal drag therefore grows downward at the same time; vertical-only stretching cannot persist.
saveVideoGallery.contextMenu: native ComfyUI node menu with Video Combine-style preview actions (Open/Save preview, filepath/workflow, Pause/Hide/Sync/Mute) plus standard/rgthree node actions
saveVideoGallery.controls: all controls and format-specific widgets exposed by the installed Video Combine, plus bit_depth
saveVideoGallery.browserPreview: gallery may create a hidden H.264 playback proxy only when the master codec is not browser-friendly; Open/Save always target the original master
saveVideoGallery.saveCorrectness: encoding remains delegated to the installed VHS_VideoCombine and the completed master is verified on disk before history is updated
saveVideoGallery.frontendCompatibility: uses window.comfyAPI.widgetInputs when available; no direct import of deprecated /extensions/core/widgetInputs.js legacy shim
saveVideoGallery.bitDepthCompatibility: Explicit bit depth is enforced when the active Video Combine preset exposes pix_fmt. Presets that intentionally hide pix_fmt (including ProRes in some VHS builds) are delegated unchanged instead of aborting; the saved master is then probed and its actual pixel depth is recorded when ffprobe can determine it.
saveVideoGallery.audioHover: Video Combine parity: preview is forced muted whenever the pointer is outside the video; VHS.DefaultMute preference is applied only while hovering.
saveVideoGallery.syncPreview: Shares the native vhs_preview class/contract so Sync preview works bidirectionally between Lyonir Save Video and VHS Video Combine.
saveVideoGallery.previewPriority: The current video is always the dominant visual surface and cannot remain tiny inside a large node. Media uses width:100% / height:auto like VHS, avoiding object-fit letterboxing caused by oversized DOM containers.
saveVideoGallery.historySizing: Prior-video thumbnails are capped to a compact 24–48 px range so history never steals significant space from the main preview.
saveVideoGallery.historyIdentity: Persistent per-node UUID stored only in node.properties; no visible lyonir_history_id widget/input. New nodes start empty, reloads restore only their own history, and clones are deduplicated.

lyonir.galleryGeometryFix: v3.5.13 preserves all v3.5.12 history isolation and moves the persistent UUID out of the visible input/widget surface into serialized node properties only.

imageCompare.ui: preview-first transparent A/B compare surface matching Save Image behavior
imageCompare.layout: no black placeholder panel; no instructional empty-state text; compare area fills the node body
imageCompare.contextMenu: Open Image, Copy Image, Save Image, MaskEditor; action follows the image under the pointer
